about: In memory: those who died on a flight, preparing to fly, or in ground work and tests, each with at least two sources and one plain sentence of fact. Written by scripts/spaceflight/build_crews.py (scripts/spaceflight/in_memory.py). No name is guessed: where the sources give a number of dead but not every name, 'unconfirmed' says so.
